events.title: Major Update Live: Party of 3 Heroes
events.summary: Hey Handslayers,The big update is here.We’ve completely overhauled how runs work. What used to be a single-character adventure is now a full party experience.What’s newParty of 3 Heroes: You no longer start a run with just one character. You now embark with a party of 3 heroes.Lane Swapping: During battle you can freely swap lanes between your heroes. Positioning now matters.New Heroes + Roles: A large number of new heroes have been added. Every hero now has a clear role:TankAssassinMageWarriorV

events.title: Big Update Incoming: From Solo Character to Party of 3
events.summary: Dear Handslayers,We’re making a big change.After watching how people play the demo, one thing became clear: a lot of you are finishing runs too quickly. The core loop is fun, the builds feel good, but the runs themselves don’t last long enough.So we’re adjusting the foundation.What’s changing Instead of controlling 1 character per run, you’ll now select and build a party of 3 characters.Why we’re doing thisRuns will be meaningfully longer and deeperSynergies between characters will matter a lot

events.title: Handslayer Demo Available Now!
events.summary: The Handslayer Demo is live!Forget traditional poker. In Handslayer, every battle is a tactical three-hand duel.Carefully arrange your cards, predict your opponent’s moves, and outplay them with clever synergies.
